ideas.pitch: An AI-powered campus energy management platform that optimizes local solar generation and battery storage to reduce peak demand charges for the University of Florida.
ideas.title: GatorGreen Campus Microgrid Optimizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: It targets local operational cost-saving mechanics for a university campus environment, making it immediately relatable to local judges and presenting clear utility metrics.

ideas.pitch: A computer vision and IoT sensor dashboard designed to monitor wetland water quality metrics and flag ecological anomalies in real time for local conservationists.
ideas.title: SwampWatch Aquatic Ecosystem Sentinel
ideas.why_it_could_win: It leverages regional environmental themes relevant to north-central Florida, capturing judge interest through direct ecological relevance.

ideas.pitch: A dynamic campus shuttle scheduling platform that uses predictive passenger load modeling to reroute transit vehicles during peak class-change hours.
ideas.title: GatorRoute Smart Transit Sync
ideas.why_it_could_win: Every student at an in-person hackathon in Gainesville deals with transit bottlenecks, providing an instantly understandable demonstration during the final pitch.

ideas.pitch: A decentralized micro-marketplace facilitating inventory sharing and equipment rentals between student-run organizations and local Gainesville pop-up vendors.
ideas.title: CampusCartus Local Vendor Exchange
ideas.why_it_could_win: It addresses community logistics with a functional transactional flow, scoring high on practical usability and user experience design.

ideas.pitch: An AI-driven study group formation engine that pairs university students based on complementary skill gaps and assignment deadlines rather than random signups.
ideas.title: StudyHive Peer Skill Matcher
ideas.why_it_could_win: It solves an omnipresent student pain point with a clean matching algorithm, making the core value proposition exceptionally easy for judges to test live.
